patches.reason: Add HunkCompressor::compress_owned so a compressed hunk can own its input and move to the thread that writes it, letting callers compress on worker threads without keeping every read buffer alive.

Add CodecImplementation::with_level and ChdWriteOptions::compression_levels for Deflate (0-9), LZMA (0-9, LzmaEncProps_Normalize mapping), Zstandard and FLAC (0-8, libFLAC stereo and LPC presets). Defaults stay the chdman levels; CD subcode keeps the default level.

Skip the CD FLAC trial when other codecs are configured and every frame of the hunk starts with the data-sector sync header, matching rom-weaver's previous encoder. Unlike chdman, a data hunk that FLAC would compress best is stored with another codec.

Use std::sync::RwLock for the shared hunk index instead of parking_lot. On wasm32 parking_lot parks only with its nightly feature, so a contended lock panicked with 'Parking not supported on this platform' on browser wasi-threads; std's lock works there and the parking_lot dependency goes away.

Inline the library as a workspace module: rename lib.rs to mod.rs and rewrite crate:: and doctest chd:: paths to crate::chd_rs:: and rom_weaver_containers::chd_rs::. mod.rs appears as a delete and add because patch renames are unsupported.

Resolve feature gates to the pinned set (std, encode, huff_write, fast_zstd, verify_block_crc, want_subcode, want_raw_data_sector, codec_api on; huffman_api, nonstandard_channel_count and both iterator features off), deleting the zrip zstd backend, the lender-based iter module and docs.rs attributes.
Take zstd_safe from the workspace zstd crate's re-export instead of a separate zstd-safe dependency, in the codec and its compressor tests.
Apply workspace rustfmt (edition 2024 import order and blank lines left by feature resolution); formatting only.
Workspace clippy and rustc 2024 fixes: elided lifetimes, div_ceil, is_multiple_of, io::Error::other, collapsible ifs, non-overlapping FLAC precision ranges and CompressedHunk::is_empty.

Drop the upstream read tests that need .testimages fixtures the repository does not ship, and make the module-level doc examples compile as no_run (main wrappers, metadata_refs without ?, collected refs read through Chd::inner).
